why_this_file_exists: A trial identity's first measurement is immutable on purpose: it is the number the trial STARTED with, and editing it would falsify the ledger that makes trial accounting meaningful. But a first measurement can later be found to have been produced by a defect, and publishing that number bare -- inside a ranked distribution, with no mention that it was withdrawn -- asserts a claim this record has retracted. Deleting it is dishonest and asserting it is dishonest. This file names the third option: the number stays, and its retraction travels with it.
how_it_is_enforced: scripts/build-trial-distribution.mjs resolves each entry's label to a hypothesis key from the published trial packets, requires the named correction artifact to exist and to record a withdrawing verdict, and quotes the corrected figure FROM that artifact rather than restating it here. A label that matches no packet, a missing artifact, or a verdict that is not a withdrawal fails the build. Nothing in this file is a number anyone typed.

superseded.label: cpi_surprise_size
superseded.why: Deployed 2026-08-10 at a quarter of the book on a verdict of ADD. A 2026-08-16 re-run with a calendar correction that retains zero-exposure sessions flipped the pre-registered Newey-West check to FALSE and recorded a verdict of KILLED. The published figures did not move for three days, because they were hard-coded in the publisher rather than read from the artifact.
